name: IOI Properties Group Berhad
overview: IOI Properties Group Berhad 今年完成两项重大交易：以约 RM7.58 billion 将多项物业出售给新成立的 IOIPG REIT 并完成 REIT 上市，同时以约 SGD1,196.704 million 收购 MVKIMI (BVI) Limited 及以 SGD1.00 收购 Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd. 并偿还股东垫款。酒店资产通过售后回租方式继续由集团租回经营。
overview_en: IOI Properties Group Berhad completed two major transactions this year: the disposal of several properties to the newly established IOIPG REIT for approximately RM7.58 billion with the REIT listing completed, and the acquisitions of MVKIMI (BVI) Limited for approximately SGD1,196.704 million and Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd. for SGD1.00 plus repayment of shareholder advances. The hotel assets continue to be operated by the group under leaseback arrangements.

segments.name: 物业投资
segments.note: 今年将多项投资物业出售给新成立的 IOIPG REIT，并完成 REIT 上市。
segments.note_en: This year disposed several investment properties to the newly established IOIPG REIT and completed the REIT listing.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 以约 RM7.58 billion 将多项物业出售给 IOIPG REIT，其中约 RM2.65 billion 以现金支付，余额以 REIT 单位支付，交易已完成。
actions.text_en: Disposed several properties to IOIPG REIT for approximately RM7.58 billion, satisfied by approximately RM2.65 billion cash and the balance in REIT units; the disposal was completed.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 批准 IOIPG REIT 上市 5,500,000,000 个单位，以及最多 300,000,000 个新单位作为管理费支付。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing of 5,500,000,000 units of IOIPG REIT and up to 300,000,000 new units as payment of management fees.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: IOIPG REIT 于 2026 年 9 月 11 日成立，卖方与受托人于 2026 年 9 月 14 日签署物业买卖协议。
actions.text_en: IOIPG REIT was established on 11 September 2026, and the vendors entered into property sale and purchase agreements with the trustee on 14 September 2026.

segments.name: 酒店与休闲
segments.note: 今年将多家酒店出售给 IOIPG REIT，并由集团旗下公司作为主租户租回经营。
segments.note_en: This year disposed several hotels to IOIPG REIT, with group companies acting as master lessees to lease back and operate them.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 将 Le Meridien Putrajaya、Moxy Putrajaya、Putrajaya Marriott Hotel、Four Points by Sheraton Puchong、Courtyard by Marriott Penang 等酒店出售给 IOIPG REIT，并由 ICHSB、RVDSB、IB…
actions.text_en: Disposed hotels including Le Meridien Putrajaya, Moxy Putrajaya, Putrajaya Marriott Hotel, Four Points by Sheraton Puchong and Courtyard by Marriott Penang to IOIPG REIT, leased back with ICHSB, RVDSB and IBHSB as master lessees.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年完成两项新加坡物业相关收购，扩大投资物业组合。
segments.note_en: This year completed two Singapore property-related acquisitions, expanding the investment property portfolio.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购 Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd.，购买代价 SGD1.00（约 RM3.19），并偿还股东垫款 SGD217.32 million（约 RM693.07 million）。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of Shenton 101 Pte. Ltd. for a purchase consideration of SGD1.00 (approximately RM3.19) and repaid shareholder advances of SGD217.32 million (approximately RM693.07 million).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购 MVKIMI (BVI) Limited，购买代价约 SGD1,196.704 million（约 RM3,844.771 million），并偿还股东贷款约 SGD1,277.504 million（约 RM4,104.365 million）。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of MVKIMI (BVI) Limited for a purchase consideration of approximately SGD1,196.704 million (approximately RM3,844.771 million) and repaid shareholder loans of approximately SGD1,277.504 million (approximately RM4,104.365 million).

model_changes.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
model_changes.text: 通过成立 IOIPG REIT 并将多项物业出售给该 REIT，同时通过售后回租继续经营酒店。
model_changes.text_en: By establishing IOIPG REIT and disposing several properties to the REIT, the group moved part of its investment property and hotel assets into the REIT while continuing to operate the hotels under sale-and-leaseback arrangements.
